Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain open/P3; the original design task is coherent and not stale. ReducedRankGlsPrepared.prepare currently accepts voxelwise whitening only for a full-rank request with Conditional inference, uses a GLS fallback and records ReducedRankFullRankVoxelwiseFallback with target/event-only inference scope. Compressed or bootstrap voxelwise-AR requests explicitly return UnsupportedEngine. ChunkedFitExecutorSuite contains separate tests for the full-rank fallback and compressed refusal; these were inspected, not rerun in this assessment.

Preserve this distinction in future design: do not describe all voxelwise-AR RRG as unsupported or treat the full-rank fallback as evidence for compression. The proposed shared response subspace must specify its metric under heterogeneous whitening, nuisance elimination, how training/selection of that subspace is shared across chunks, and conditional-versus-selection/whitening-estimation uncertainty. Grouping by whitening geometry must define exact versus approximate grouping and its error contract. Independent full-rank limiting cases and batch/chunk invariance remain necessary; deleting the guard or silently using pooled/shared whitening is not implementation. No new mathematical admission, tests, performance result or code change is claimed here.
